      simpa only [hJ] using c.property
    simpa only [Submodule.mem_bot] using hc'

    rw [← s.apply_symm_apply u, hs]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero

    rw [hc]

  have htop : (⊤ : Submodule ℂ V) ≤ ⊥ := by
    rw [← hspan]
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    intro m hm
    have hmL : m ∈ L p M := Submodule.subset_span hm
    simpa only [Submodule.mem_bot] using hLzero ⟨m, hmL⟩
  let i : Ix l := ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ _⟩
  have hz : ev y v i.val = 0 := by
    have hz' : ev y v i.val ∈ (⊥ : Submodule ℂ V) := htop (Submodule.mem_top)
    simpa only [Submodule.mem_bot] using hz'
  exact (h_T005.2.1 i).1 hz
